Keyboard Shortcuts

The whole game plays from the keyboard: roll, hold, rearrange and score without touching the mouse.

Settings

How to Play

On your turn, roll the five dice up to 3 times. After any roll, tap dice to hold them, held dice hover up front and stay put on the next roll. You can also drag any die left or right, on the 3D table or on the chips under it, to rearrange your dice into any order you like; the values and holds travel with each die. On a keyboard, focus a chip under the table and press the left or right arrow keys to walk that die along the tray. When you're done rolling, tap a box on the score card to lock in that category. Every box is used exactly once, so choose carefully. Scored the wrong box? Tap Undo to take back your last score and pick a different box for the same dice, but only until the next player rolls. After 13 rounds the highest grand total wins.

Upper Section

Aces through SixesAdd up only the dice showing that face. Fill the whole upper section with 63+ total to earn the 35-point bonus.

Lower Section

3 of a KindThree matching dice → add all five dice
4 of a KindFour matching dice → add all five dice
Full HouseThree of one + two of another → 25
Small StraightAny run of 4 (e.g. 2-3-4-5) → 30
Large StraightRun of 5 → 40
YAHTZEEAll five matching → 50
ChanceAdd all five dice, no combo needed

Yahtzee Bonus & Joker

Roll another Yahtzee after scoring 50 in the Yahtzee box and you bank a 100-point bonus for each one. It also plays as a joker: if the matching upper box is still open you must score it there (5 × the face); otherwise it counts as a full Full House (25), Small Straight (30) or Large Straight (40) in the lower section.
